_why: Three surfaces serve the same three signed records. Independence is the whole
point: any one of them can be down, seized, or lying, and a reader can still
get a correct record from another and verify it against the transparency log.
That property is not created by having three names. It is created by the three
names sharing NO hosting provider, NO DNS provider, and NO registrar. Those are
each a single point that takes down or takes over every surface that depends on
it. tools/test_mirror_independence.py asserts the columns are pairwise disjoint,
because this is exactly the kind of invariant that is true the day it is written
and quietly false a year later when one name gets moved for an unrelated reason.
The registrar column is here because a domain can be lost at the registrar
without any DNS or hosting change at all, and nothing else tracks it.
